seeded_from.use: circuit.json byte for byte and compilation_seed 20, the identifier of mesh 29dc6ef8

preregistered.series: off-cone packet origin on the job-16 circuit and seed (pool row QPU-43)
preregistered.jobs: job-00 and job-02 send the server's default mitigations and job-01 sends mitigations = [], run in the order job-00, job-01, job-02; the three run unconditionally, and no presence count of an earlier job gates a later one
preregistered.void: a source-20 entry is void when its served mesh sha256 does not start with 29dc6ef8; a source-22 entry is void when its returned mesh, whichever it is, leaves any of modes 0, 1, 5 inside the cone of that mesh and source (scripts/qd_belenos_cone.py); an entry of either source is void when its computed_input is not one photon on its setting's input_mode or its recorded samples differ from its max_samples. The returned mesh sha256 of every entry is reported beside its presences. Entries come in adjacent source pairs of one level, and a results_list that ends before iterations (a cut at max_duration) keeps its completed pairs: the contrasts read the observed exposures of the valid entries and the unpaired trailing entry is dropped. No presence count voids a job
preregistered.observable: per entry, over the modes outside the cone of the entry's returned mesh and source (scripts/qd_belenos_cone.py) other than mode 5, the presences (the primary count): the off-cone modes whose one-click count is at least 32. Mode 5 is a separate secondary readout with its own presences, never added to the primary count. An off-cone count from 1 to 31 is a break of the zero-or-packet law and is reported beside the presences

source_separation.disjoint_source_pair: none on mesh 29dc6ef8: of the twelve connected sources only 20 and 22 keep modes 0, 1 and 5 off-cone, and their lit detector sets overlap; a source 22 entry that returns another mesh brings its own cone and ideal shares, which the live plan read of the returned meshes states before submission
source_separation.degenerate_with_window_samples: source-independent photon-triggered episodes (a packet per photon burst on any detector) give equal presences per sample for both sources and at every level, which is the window_samples prediction; the design separates detector-resolved episodes only, and the reading 'window_samples or source-independent episodes' stays one reading

mechanisms.episodes: detector-resolved photon-triggered packets: presences per sample follow the photons on the detectors the source lights, so source 20 reads up to 1.671 times the presences per sample of source 22 on 29dc6ef8 (ratio 1 would read no source effect)
mechanisms.window_samples: noise over a window proportional to the recorded samples at a source-independent rate, or source-independent photon-triggered episodes: equal presences per sample for both sources and at every level
mechanisms.window_time: noise over the true acquisition window, samples over physical_perf: equal for both sources, and presences per sample at 1500 samples above those at 60000 by physical_perf(60000) / physical_perf(1500) = 17.6
mechanisms.balancing: the default DetectorBalancing processing amplifies rare raw clicks into packets (it creates no click on a zero-count mode): job-01 (mitigations = []) reads fewer presences than the default jobs on both sides of it

contrasts.drift: presences of job-02 against job-00 over their equal exposures: two-sided exact binomial test of job-02's share of the pair at 1/2, alpha 0.05
contrasts.mitigation: presences of job-01 against the pooled job-00 and job-02 over their equal exposures: two-sided exact binomial test of job-01's share of the three at 1/3, alpha 0.05
contrasts.source: presences of source 22 against source 20 over the pooled default jobs: two-sided exact binomial test of source 22's share at the exposure share, alpha 0.05; pooled over all three jobs when the mitigation contrast does not reject
contrasts.level: presences at 1500 samples against those at 60000 over the same pooled jobs: two-sided exact binomial test of the 1500 share at the sample-law share, alpha 0.05, and the same test at the time-law share

readings.balancing: the drift contrast does not reject and the mitigation contrast rejects with job-01's share below 1/3
readings.episodes: the mitigation contrast does not reject and the source contrast rejects with source 22's share below the exposure share
readings.window_samples: neither the mitigation nor the source contrast rejects, the sample-law share holds and the time-law share is rejected (or source-independent photon-triggered episodes)
readings.window_time: neither the mitigation nor the source contrast rejects, the time-law share holds and the sample-law share is rejected
readings.no attribution: any other pattern, a rejected drift contrast, a void job, or a level contrast whose two tests both hold or both reject

preregistered.power_basis: exact Poisson counts at 1.0841e-04 primary presences per sample (49 in 452,000 samples of the 58 iterated cells of docs/evidence/quandela/belenos_offcone_packets.json, modes other than 5); the source rows hold the pooled total at the retained rate (fixed_total) or scale source 22 down to 1 / ratio of the retained rate (source_22_scaled); retained packets of one cell co-occur across modes 0 and 5 (20 cells against 13.9 expected), so the table is an upper bound on every power entry
